title: ECB backs tokenized EU capital markets with strict guardrails
summary: The European Central Bank said tokenization could improve EU capital markets, but only with central bank money, interoperable infrastructure and resilient regulation.

title: Bernstein says Bitcoin market already priced in quantum risk
summary: Bernstein says Bitcoin’s selloff already reflects quantum risk and that developers still have time to agree on a post-quantum upgrade path.

title: Strategy buys 13,927 Bitcoin for $1B, holdings near 800,000 BTC
summary: Michael Saylor’s Strategy acquired 13,927 Bitcoin for $1 billion last week, funding the purchase through STRC share sales, lifting the company’s holdings to 780,897 BTC.

title: StarkWare cuts staff in push toward revenue-generating products
summary: StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson said the company will split into two units as it adopts a faster and leaner “startup mode.”

title: Nigel Farage-backed Stack BTC adds $2.7M in Bitcoin to treasury
summary: Nigel Farage-backed Stack BTC bought $2.7 million of Bitcoin, deepening the Reform UK leader’s crypto ties as the UK moves to curb crypto donations.

title: South Korea says API crypto trading now makes up 30% of market: Report
summary: South Korea’s FSS said API trading now makes up 30% of crypto turnover and warned it will crack down on abusive automated trading patterns, local media reported Monday.

title: Crypto ETPs see $1.1B inflows, strongest gains since January
summary: Crypto ETPs recorded $1.1 billion in inflows last week, led by Bitcoin and US spot ETFs, as easing US inflation data and geopolitical tensions supported demand.

title: Justin Sun presses WLFI to identify wallets behind freeze powers
summary: Sun urged the Trump-linked WLFi platform to disclose who controls the multi-sig and smart contract behind the platform, days after its governance token hit a new low.

title: Hyperbridge attacker mints 1B bridged Polkadot tokens in $237K exploit
summary: A Hyperbridge exploit let an attacker mint 1 billion bridged Polkadot tokens on Ethereum and cash out about $237,000, reviving debate over bridge security.

title: Oil price surges 8% on Iran tensions: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
summary: Bitcoin preserved $70,000 at the weekly close as markets began reacting to a breakdown in US-Iran negotiations and blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.
